claims.assertion: Existing No restored and retained: Law 4994/2022 requires covered service providers to make Annex V conformity information available to the public in accessible written and oral forms, but does not expressly require a dedicated accessibility-statement page.
claims.review_note: The statutory public-information duty is distinct from an express dedicated-page requirement. Isolated Greek-to-English review by /root/greek_language on 2026-09-24, fork_turns=none: Supported; the reviewer agreed that No is reasonable for a column asking whether a dedicated accessibility-statement-style page is expressly required.

claims.assertion: Law 4994/2022 designates four product-surveillance arrangements: the Industrial Products Safety and Compliance Directorate for computer hardware/operating systems, e-readers, payment terminals and ATMs; EETT for electronic-communications terminal equipment; the General Secretariat for Transport jointly with the Directorate for ticketing, check-in and interactive information terminals; and ESR jointly with the Directorate for audiovisual-access terminal equipment.
claims.review_note: Isolated Greek-to-English review by /root/greek_language on 2026-09-24, fork_turns=none: all four mappings Supported.

claims.assertion: EETT is the competent authority for monitoring and checking compliance of electronic-communications services.
claims.review_note: Isolated Greek-to-English review by /root/greek_language on 2026-09-24, fork_turns=none: Supported.

claims.assertion: ESR imposes sanctions on media service providers for breaches of obligations under Law 4994/2022.
claims.review_note: Isolated Greek-to-English review by /root/greek_language on 2026-09-24, fork_turns=none corrected a broader draft: the excerpt says media service providers and imposes sanctions; the public wording uses that narrower phrasing.

claims.assertion: Economic operators relying on Article 14(1) must inform the relevant market-surveillance or service-compliance authority; the notification requirement does not apply to microenterprises.
